reviews.rationale: Selected-source sequential comparison of the Q3 event against the Q2 baseline shows broad softness on the GAAP and adjusted earnings lines alongside a lower revenue base and higher operating expenses, while free cash flow improved and the adjusted EPS guidance range was held. The selected rows do not reconcile the free cash flow move, do not separate organic from acquired or currency effects, and do not explain why revenue and adjusted EBITDA guidance ranges were lowered while the adjusted EPS range was unchanged. Because the required event metrics are present but the drivers, segment detail and full-year bridge are not, the thesis is placed on hold pending a complete filing review rather than upgraded or invalidated.
